**Problem / motivation**
What are you trying to recover or do that RecoverD can't today?

**Proposed feature**
What you'd like RecoverD to do.

**File systems / formats involved (if any)**
e.g. APFS, HFS+, a specific carve signature or container format.

**Security-model impact**
RecoverD never writes device contents to the host outside an explicit export, and never copies the
device. Describe how your idea fits within that invariant (or why it needs discussion).

**Alternatives considered**
Other tools or approaches you've tried.

**Additional context**
Anything else — links to format specs, sample layouts, etc.
